paper_route: Revised main-track candidate after fair-control and reporting fixes
claim_scope: Real-data causal validation is now carried by Favorita promotion; PRF is semi-synthetic only; M6 completed the fair-control D0/D1/D2 protocol on DLinear, PatchTST, TiDE, and TimeXer. The remaining claim boundary is that this is an intervention-oriented scenario-forecasting submission under stated assumptions, not a full leaderboard SOTA claim across every TSF benchmark.

M6.label: PASS_FAIR_CONTROL_PROTOCOL
M6.fairness: D0/D1/D2 share item static controls; D1/D2 share item-specific response capacity

headline_claims: H1 CONFIRMED (scoped): observational MISO estimators exhibit material scenario bias (D0 sign-error rate 100.0% at calibrated γ̂), while observational WMAPE is blind to the failure.
H3 CONFIRMED: DoCast (D2) reduces elasticity RMSE by 65.8% vs D0 at -1.24% observational accuracy cost — hidden-confounder stress-test improvement in the current linear MISO ablation.

FAIR-CONTROL CHECK: when D0/D1/D2 all receive item controls, RMSE is 0.1939/0.5105/0.2154; D2 reduces RMSE vs the fair D1 structural head by 58.0%. The controlled D0 result is reported separately and is not claimed as an orthogonal-loss win.

H5 REAL A-TYPE: Favorita promotion NEE 0.1051 < D0 NEE 0.3088 (66.0% reduction; unit Wilcoxon p=1.36e-24) against matched within-unit ATT; mean paired NEE delta 0.0496 (95% CI [0.04, 0.0596]); robustness grid median reduction 60.7%, max p=<1e-300.
H5 REAL A-TYPE #2: M5 markdown NEE 0.0264 < D0 NEE 0.0775 (65.9% reduction; unit Wilcoxon p=3.22e-16; mean paired NEE delta 0.0129, 95% CI [0.0096, 0.0163]).
PRF SEMI-SYNTHETIC: DoCast Kendall-τ 1.000 on candidate price plans (decision stress test, not counted as real-data validation).

M6 FAIR-CONTROL DEEP-BACKBONE PROTOCOL: PatchTST, TiDE, and TimeXer all pass D0/D1/D2; PatchTST (52.9% θ-RMSE reduction vs fair D1, -2.04% WMAPE change), TiDE (52.1% θ-RMSE reduction vs fair D1, -1.05% WMAPE change), TimeXer (55.7% θ-RMSE reduction vs fair D1, -1.54% WMAPE change).
